the neural correlates of perceiving expressive targets depend on perceivers' task set.
the neural bases of perceivers' processing of targets' emotions and eye gaze depend on perceivers' task set.
the neural bases of social perception are sensitive to the social context of perception, and that this sensitivity is driven by perceivers’ goals.

how the brain represents and responds to the emotional expressions of other people.
the neural bases of social cognition.
the neural basis of social cognition.

the results of this study show that the neural bases of the perception of expressive targets are different than that of inexpressive targets.
the neural correlates of social perception depend on both task and target.
the neural bases of social perception depend on the task and the goals of the perceiver.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the social environment can affect social cognition.
the way we perceive others depends on the task we perform and on the emotional expressivity of the target.
the neural bases of social perception are not only influenced by the perceiver but also by the target.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the neural bases of social cognition depend on the goals of the perceiver, and that the goals of the social perceiver can be influenced by the goals and behaviors of their social targets.
the brain's social processing depends on the social context, which in our case is the social relationship between the perceiver and target.
the neural bases of social cognition depend on interpersonal factors.
